#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Combined worst case: 4096 flows, 1e6 packets, 100k requests, 3 checkpoints."""
import json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
SUB="/workspace/submission/main.py"
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); path=os.path.join(d,"p.json"); inp=os.path.join(d,"in.jsonl"); outf=os.path.join(d,"out.jsonl")
prog=json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=json.dumps(
 {"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,
  "rules":[{"id":0,"class":1,"priority":5,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]*31+[[0,0]]}]+
          [{"id":i,"class":2,"priority":1,"ranges":[[0,0]]} for i in range(1,2048)],
  "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}}).encode(),
 stdout=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=60).stdout)
open(path,"w").write(json.dumps(prog))
NREQ=100000; NF=4096; TOTAL=1000000
per_req=TOTAL//NREQ
t=0; f=0
with open(inp,"w") as fh:
    for i in range(NREQ):
        if i % 33333 == 0 and i:
            fh.write(json.dumps({"op":"checkpoint"})+"\n")
            continue
        if i < NF:
            fh.write(json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":i,"time":i})+"\n")
            continue
        ch=[]
        for _ in range(per_req):
            t+=1
            ch.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":t%2,"length":1+((t*7919)%2048)})
        f=(f+1)%NF
        fh.write(json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":ch})+"\n")
print("input %.1fMB"%(os.path.getsize(inp)/1e6))
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
    fd0=os.open(inp,os.O_RDONLY); os.dup2(fd0,0)
    fd1=os.open(outf,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC); os.dup2(fd1,1)
    fd=os.open(os.devnull,os.O_WRONLY); os.dup2(fd,2)
    os.execv(sys.executable,[sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"stream",path])
t0=time.time()
_,status,ru=os.wait4(pid,0)
dt=time.time()-t0
print("status=%d %.2fs peakrss=%.1fMB out=%.2fMB"%(status,dt,ru.ru_maxrss/1024,os.path.getsize(outf)/1e6))
print("requests:", sum(1 for _ in open(inp)))
PYEOF
